text: Yield<'a>: Borrow<Record> on Indexable has nothing to do with mutability. It is what lets an in-memory collection lend &Record while a disk-backed one yields an owned, freshly parsed Record, through one API, and every combinator is agnostic to which. Indexable's invariant is that get(i) is Some for every i < len(); breaking it panics rather than erroring because a lying implementor is a bug, not a runtime condition. Iterable is blanket-implemented over every Indexable and nobody writes one by hand.
